blue.$description: Light highlight, such as a selected item.

light.$description: Secondary areas, such as action bars and fields.

room.$description: The dark background of the meeting room.

room-overlay.$description: Translucent layer on the room background.

room-overlay-strong.$description: Solid, stronger layer on the room background.

error.$description: Outline of a field with an error.

focus-ring.$description: Ring around a focused field. Use it together with colors.border.selected, never instead of it.

selected.$description: Outline of a focused or selected item.

1.$description: Main actions, links and highlighted text.

dark-gray.$description: Base value. Prefer colors.text.default for text.

error.$description: Errors and destructive actions, such as leaving or ending.

dark.$description: Hover on a main action filled with the brand color.

light.$description: Hover on an item with a light brand background.

light-gray.$description: Base value. Prefer colors.background.light for backgrounds.

2.$description: Base value. Prefer colors.text.light or colors.icon.default.

3.$description: Base value. Prefer colors.border.default for outlines.

4.$description: Base value. Prefer colors.hover.neutral for hover.

default.$description: Shadow of elements that sit above the page, such as menus.

success.$description: Success, such as a good connection.

success-dark.$description: Fill behind a white icon or text that reports success.

on-dark.$description: Text on the dark room background.

you.$description: Avatar of the person using the app.

warning-dark.$description: Fill behind a white icon or text that reports a warning.

white.$description: Base value. Prefer colors.background.white for backgrounds and colors.icon.white for icons.

dot.$description: Dot that shows there is something new.

notification-border.$description: Border of a notification in the sidebar.

surface.$description: Light surface of a video. For the area behind a video, use colors.background.video.

default.$description: Medium controls and containers, about 40 to 600px, such as buttons, fields, cards and modals.

small.$description: Elements up to about 40px, such as list items, tooltips and square icon buttons.

x-large.$description: Containers as tall as the screen, such as a sidebar.

full.$description: Circles and pills, such as avatars, badges and circular buttons. Use it instead of half the size.

none.$description: No rounding, for items that fill the full width of a rounded container, such as menu items.

large.$description: Large containers where borderRadiusDefault feels small. Use sparingly.
Padding of panels and modals, and the space between sections.

medium.$description: Padding of medium components, such as fields and cards, and the default space between elements.

medium-large.$description: Occasional use. Prefer spacingMedium or spacingLarge.

small.$description: Between related items, such as list items, menu items and icons in a group.

small-medium.$description: Between a title and its content inside a section.

x-small.$description: Minimum space, such as between a short icon and its text, or the vertical padding of pills and tooltips.

big.$description: Used by BBBToggle, BBBSlider and BBBToast. Elsewhere prefer fontSizeDefault.

default.$description: Default text, panel titles and buttons.

x-small.$description: Minimum supporting text and small labels. Nothing smaller.

large.$description: Large menus and captions over video.

x-large.$description: Highlight titles, such as in empty states.

display.$description: Large numbers, such as timers. Not for text.

hard.$description: Panel titles and selected items. Not for emphasis inside running text.

subtle.$description: Small raised controls, such as a slider thumb or a send button.

whiteboard.$description: Panels and buttons on the whiteboard, so that they match the ones of tldraw.

focus.$description: Ring around a focused field. Use it together with the colors.border.selected outline, never instead of it.

default.$description: Default text, list and navigation items.

text2.$description: Labels, descriptions and chat messages. In the secondary text color.

text3.$description: Times and marks. In the secondary text color.

large.$description: Large menus and captions over video.

panel.$description: Panel and modal headers. In uppercase.

highlight.$description: Empty states and highlight titles, one per screen.

small.$description: Names on video tiles, small badges and counters.
